name: W26 Morning Flow — Bodyweight Spine + Hip (All Days, Rotated Variety)
description:
The daily 15-minute opener. This week rotates roughly half the moves again: the primer swaps to **low-lunge thoracic rotation + inchworm walkout**, the work block picks up the **McGill crunch, plank shoulder taps and fire hydrants**, and the yoga arc trades couch stretch and happy baby for **frog stretch and straddle reaches**. Anchors stay put: scorpion, lizard, cossack, the push-up greasing set, and the rehab cluster in the day-specific add-on.

**This flow is also your readiness screen.** You called last week's legs day before it started — the cossacks felt easy and flexy and you knew going in it would be good. That read has been more reliable than sleep quality. Pay attention to it.

**Order is deliberate.** Primer wakes the spine, work block warms the body, and the deep stretch arc goes last because warm muscle stretches further. Don't reorder it to get the stretching over with.

sets.name: Primer — Wake the Spine (~3 min)
sets.notes: Slow and unhurried. You just got out of bed — this is about getting the spine and hips to agree to move, not about a stimulus.

exercises.notes: 45s each side. Low lunge, hand down, reach the other arm to the ceiling. **Rotate from the mid-back and let the eyes follow the hand** — the front hip opens at the same time. Two jobs in one shape.
Hinge, walk the hands out to a plank, walk them back. **Legs as straight as the hamstrings allow** — this is the first honest read on how the posterior chain woke up.
Tight fists, thumbs tucked, hinged slightly forward. Wakes the deep core before anything loaded.

sets.name: Work Block — Bodyweight Activation (~5 min)
sets.notes: Warm the body. **Activate, don't fatigue** — this precedes a gym session most days.

exercises.notes: The greasing set. **Never to failure** — leave 2-3 in the tank, every single day. Elbows ~45°, shoulders packed DOWN not shrugged up.
Rotated in. One knee bent, hands under the low back, lift only the head and shoulders — **the low back never flattens into the hands.** A posture-check curl-up, not an ab burner.
Rotated in. Plank, tap the opposite shoulder. **Hips do not rotate** — widen the feet if they do. This is anti-rotation work disguised as an arm movement.

Rotated in. On all fours, lift the bent knee out to the side. **Keep the hips square to the floor** — the temptation is to roll open and swing. Glute medius, which is the same muscle the Bulgarians ask to level your pelvis.

sets.name: Yoga Flow — Deep Stretch Arc (~7 min)
sets.notes: One continuous arc — flow between shapes rather than stopping and setting up each one. Body is warm now, so these go deeper than they would cold.

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Prone, reach the foot across to the opposite hand. Front-of-hip and chest open together.
45s each side. Deep hip opener. Drop to the forearms if the hip allows.

**This is the readiness screen.** Depth is the project and it's working — the down heel is flat now. Sit into one hip, other leg straight, heel down, get lower than comfortable. **How these feel today is the best predictor you have of how the session will go.**

Rotated in. Knees wide, shins in line with the thighs, hips sinking back. **Go slowly and breathe into it** — the adductors don't respond to force, they respond to time. Long holds are what fascia answers.
Rotated in. Seated wide straddle — reach to each foot, then centre. **Hinge from the hips, don't round to reach further.** The straddle is the one shape the rest of the week never touches.

sets.name: 📍 Day-Specific Add-On — Pick by Today's Training (~3-5 min)
sets.notes:
Not all of these every day — pick the cluster that matches what you're about to train.

**Push day:** doorframe chest stretch · prone Y-raise · scapular push-up
**Pull day:** dead hang · scapular pull · side-lying external rotation
**KB days:** wall angel · side-lying ER · dead hang
**Legs day:** standing cross-leg lateral · pigeon · supine twist

exercises.notes: 45s each arm at MID elbow height. Push day opener.
Rehab anchor. Thumbs up, lift from the mid-back, **no shrug.**
Rehab anchor. Arms locked, move only the shoulder blades — protract and retract.
Rehab anchor, and the direct one for the right shoulder. Elbow pinned to the ribs, rotate from the shoulder.
Rehab anchor. Low back and forearms stay on the wall the whole way — **if the back arches, you've gone too high.**
Rehab anchor. Passive hang, shoulders relaxed up around the ears. Decompression.
Rehab anchor. From the hang, pull the shoulder blades DOWN without bending the elbows.
30s each side. QL release — legs day opener.
45s each side. Legs day.
30s each side. Legs day, or any day the low back is talking.

tips: **Work before stretches, always.** Warm muscle stretches deeper — that's why the yoga arc is last.
**The cossacks are the readiness read.** Easy and flexy means take the good day; stiff means hold the loads and don't probe.
**The push-up set is a greasing set, not a workout.** Leave 2-3 reps in the tank every day.
**Short beats skipped.** Ten minutes counts. Five counts.
